expectations.text: Response computes airtime as the slot divided by the panellists, giving roughly 12 to 15 minutes each, arriving in fragments of a minute or two.
expectations.evidence: "75 minutes ÷ 5 panellists = 15 minutes of raw slot each... delivered in fragments of 1-2 minutes across 6-10 turns"

expectations.text: Response cuts the ten-minute developer-portal story as unusable at that airtime.
expectations.evidence: "A 10-minute story is not a long turn on this panel, it's almost your entire airtime budget spent in one go" followed by 'Restructure into three sizes, not one'.

expectations.text: Response reduces the message count to two or three for a panel.
expectations.evidence: "The skill caps panel messages at two to three. You're at the limit, which is fine only if each one passes the one-sentence answer test."

expectations.text: Response instructs headlining each point in one sentence before any context.
expectations.evidence: "the one-sentence answer test: state it in 15-20 seconds, point first, before any context."

expectations.text: Response warns against opening a turn with agreement such as "I completely agree with what X just said".
expectations.evidence: No such warning appears anywhere in the transcript.

expectations.text: Response instructs the user to jump in unasked rather than wait to be spoken to.
expectations.evidence: "Jump in unasked. Waiting to be addressed on a 5-person panel reads as invisibility, the mirror failure to domination."

expectations.text: Response names domination as the symmetrical failure and notes the camera is on everyone the whole time.
